map.ASCII 占比多少算可读文本？: What ASCII share counts as readable text?
map.ASCII 可读性检测器，估算文本中 ASCII 与可打印字符占比，辅助判断编码: ASCII readability checker that estimates the share of ASCII and printable characters in text, helping judge the encoding and the readability of the content.
map.Base64 仅用 64 个可打印字符、ASCII 占比高但信息熵大，需结合字符: Base64 uses only 64 printable characters, so the ASCII share is high while the information entropy is large; the character distribution (whether it is only A-Za-z0-9+/=) must be examined further.
map.→ 打开ASCII 可读性检测工具: -> Open the ASCII readability check tool
map.中文会影响判定吗？: Does Chinese text affect the judgement?
map.乱码定位：中文页面乱码时对比原始与解码后 ASCII 占比，定位出错编码环节。: Garbled-text localisation: when a Chinese page turns to gibberish, compare the ASCII share of the original and of the decoded text to locate the faulty encoding step.
map.会。中文 UTF-8 单字占 3 字节均为非 ASCII，该指标侧重\"是否含大: Yes. Each Chinese character in UTF-8 takes 3 bytes and is entirely non-ASCII, so this metric focuses on "whether the text contains many binary or non-printable bytes" and cannot by itself prove Chinese garbling.
map.入库前清洗：批量文本按可读性阈值过滤非文本字段，避免二进制污染。: Clean before ingesting: for bulk text, filter out non-text fields with a readability threshold so binary data does not pollute the result.
map.无绝对阈值，可打印 ASCII 占比 >80% 且控制字符极少通常视为纯文本，具: There is no absolute threshold; a printable ASCII share above 80% with very few control characters is usually treated as plain text, and the exact cut-off depends on the business.
map.日志/抓包文本可读性初判：高 ASCII 可打印占比提示明文，低占比多为二进制或: First-pass readability judgement for logs and packet captures: a high printable ASCII share suggests plaintext, while a low share usually means binary or the wrong encoding.
map.能区分 Base64 与明文吗？: Can it distinguish Base64 from plaintext?
map.：含中文与二进制碎片的日志 ASCII 可打印占比约 62%，提示夹带非文本内容: : a log containing Chinese text and binary fragments has a printable ASCII share of about 62%, indicating non-text content is mixed in, so encoding detection is needed before ingestion.
